October 9, 2026   By Barry Dixon, LWOF Site Manager   Brighton & Hove Albion, Fixtures, Injuries, News, Predictions, Premier League, Sunderland   Google Preferred Source

# Sunderland vs Brighton: Injury News and Predicted Lineups [...] Sunderland will be without three players for this game, two being ruled out due to injuries sustained during the international break. Striker Brian Brobbey is out with a hamstring injury; however, he is expected to be back within the next week. The hamstring injury to defender Dan Ballard is unfortunately more serious, and it is likely to keep him out until at least after the next international break in November.

## Key Players

### Sunderland: Wilson Isidor [...] Pascal Gross, Charalampos Kostoulas and Chema Andres goals saw Fabian Hurzeler’s side run out 3-0 winners at Amex Stadium before the three-week international break.

## Team News

### Sunderland

The Black Cats will be without Brian Brobbey, Dan Ballard and Habib Diarra ahead of Saturday’s action. [...] Romaine Mundle remains out, whilst Reinildo is available again after serving a one-game suspension.

### Brighton & Hove Albion

Hurzeler will be hoping for a double boost ahead of the trip to the North-East.

Club captain Lewis Dunk is poised to return to the squad after he missed the win over Arsenal with a minor neck injury.

Jack Hinshelwood has also been absent since he scored twice in the 4-0 win over Aston Villa on the opening day of the season.
